notes.title: Roger, Rayleigh & Garp have officially entered the roster!
notes.content:
[h2]Yet another [b]blaze of glory[/b]. Their [b]time to shine isn't over yet[/b]. Play as [b]Gol D. Roger[/b], [b]Rayleigh (Roger Pirates First Mate)[/b] and [b]Garp (Hero of the Marines)[/b], the three of them in their youth forms.[/h2]

[previewyoutube=YrvIdzZQeEo;full][/previewyoutube]
Meet the characters of the [b]One Piece: Legend Dawn Pack DLC[/b]:
[list][*] [h3][b]Gol D. Roger, captain of the Roger Pirates. [/b][/h3]
Even held the title of Pirate King and possessed the One Piece. He is considered one of the strongest pirates of all time, an unstoppable force![/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36639876/b2ec323fb4a2e8e5cab3c2e69a16b3c264af6e6b.png[/img]
[list][*] [h3][b]Rayleigh (Roger Pirates First Mate) is a highly skilled swordsman.[/b][/h3] 
And the cunning commander of the Rogers Pirates crew as the First Mate of Gol D. Roger.[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36639876/2c479f6e0f1392648d6d903eeae0b3c858e9d1d6.png[/img]
[list][*] [h3][b]Garp (Hero of the Marines), who is the long-time respected rival of Gol D. Roger. [/b][/h3]
He is a formidable fighter in hand-to-hand combat.[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36639876/1d5c07b83d9e5fdcf18e662a3712eaea20ba538b.png[/img]
As part of the Character Pass 2, a new episode pack called [b]“Path of the King of the Pirates & Soul Map 3” is also available[/b].

[h2][b]Live up to the name of the "Pirate King"![/b][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2449171/ONE_PIECE_PIRATE_WARRIORS_4_Legend_Dawn_Pack/

notes.title: Uncover new adventures with Uta, Shanks, and Koby!
notes.content:
[h2]New characters for new adventures! Meet the [b]worldwide famous singer Uta[/b] and [b]her adoptive father - the famous Red-Haired Shanks[/b]. [b]Koby is also here[/b] to [i]complete the DLC line-up[/i] with his leader role in the Marines.[/h2]

[previewyoutube=fLYJh0MBtfc;full][/previewyoutube]
Meet the characters of the [b]One Piece Film: Red Pack DLC[/b]:
[list][*] [h3][b]Uta (Film: Red): Shanks’ adoptive daughter and a childhood friend of Luffy’s.[/b][/h3]
She is now a worldwide famous singer residing on Elegia island and seeks to start a new genesis, free from the hands of the pirates, whom she despises. Armed with her beautiful voice and the powers from the Sing-Sing Fruit, she can activate her Uta World and attack by sending the musical notes and confections she creates bouncing around. She can also transform into the Uta Knight and fly freely around the battlefield.[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36639876/419fa53a2a250153821bee03d9a6fcb9134ef277.png[/img]
[list][*] [h3][b]Shanks (Film: Red): Red-Haired Shanks has never worn his name better than now, as he returns as a playable character.[/b][/h3] 
Shanks is a skilled swordsman and powerful Haki user. Years after leaving his adoptive daughter on Elegia, he comes back to attempt to save her and the island from a tragic end.[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36639876/8707b8897c10d9959c3b9239b3fbe1de2645e849.png[/img]
[list][*] [h3][b]Koby (Film: Red): Once a shy and fearful soldier, he has come a long way to become a respected leader in the Marines. [/b][/h3]
His active role in the SWORD unit will lead him to Elegia island to investigate Uta’s influence on its inhabitants. Koby mainly fights hand-to-hand using the Six Powers. Landing his most powerful attacks will increase morale and enhance support attacks.[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36639876/791b2d0a600539f164162ca404fb7d224f838340.png[/img]

Alongside this DLC, the [b]Additional Episode 2 DLC, titled “Koby’s Combat Chronicles & Soul Map 2”[/b], releases today as well to play in single player. This new content is [i]available as part of the Additional Episode pack[/i]. 

And lastly, as the [b]characters fight off waves of enemies[/b], players can[b] listen along to the One Piece Film: Red soundtrack with the One Piece Film: Red Anime Song Pack[/b], the third DLC available for purchase today. The movie’s soundtrack can be chosen from the settings, in the [i]battle preparation screen, right before jumping into action[/i].

[h2][b]Sail into battle, pirates – the Grand Line awaits! 🏴‍☠️[/b][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2458610/ONE_PIECE_PIRATE_WARRIORS_4_Character_Pass_2/

notes.title: Play as Luffy in his Gear Five form in ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4!
notes.content:
[h2][b]ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4[/b] lets you relive [b]one of the most epic ONE PIECE arc[/b] with [b]The Battle of Onigashima Pack[/b], with [i]three characters joining the roster[/i] of the game. [/h2]

[previewyoutube=xYnRK0VzgIA;full][/previewyoutube]

Focused on [b]the Battle of Onigashima[/b], this DLC will introduce the following characters:
[list][*] [h3][b]Luffy (Onigashima Battle) Captain of the Straw Hat Pirates[/b][/h3] In a mortal fight against Kaido, the tyrant emperor ruling over Wano Country, Luffy awakens the power of the devil's fruit, transforming into Gear Five, his strongest level yet. Use the Gear Five special move with “Luffy (Onigashima Battle)” to transform temporarily and play using the Gear Five form![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36639876/19526f424c5e8800f206c7b45000d8137f3b0079.png[/img]
[list][*] [h3][b]Kaido (Onigashima Battle) Human-Beast Form of Kaido[/b][/h3] Has the ability of “Fish-Fish Fruit, Mythical Zoan, Model: Azure Dragon” covering him with scales and increasing his strength. His attacks are defined by the immense destructive power of his Haki and his iron mace. Use special moves and combos to attack, without giving the opponent a chance to retaliate. During aerial attacks, Kaido can attack multiple enemies at once in his Dragon Form.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36639876/88b67d6245b4dc84358ac60674415c406ccc01a2.png[/img]
[list][*] [h3][b]Yamato, son of Kaido[/b][/h3] Also available in this pack. Yamato uses his giant mace to deliver a wide range of attacks. He can also change to his Human-Beast form, using quick combos and ice attacks to freeze enemies in place.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36639876/cc35ce12b401933f0171fd0f511972e4fe5397c1.png[/img]

[b]The Battle of Onigashima Pack[/b] is available now and [b]part of the Character Pass 2[/b]. The Character Pass 2 [b]also includes the Character Packs 5 and 6[/b] that will be revealed later. Owners of the Character Pass 2 also get access to [b]Onigashima Battle Law Costume as a bonus item[/b].

[h2][b]"Take this seriously, I'll defeat you all!"[/b][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2458610/ONE_PIECE_PIRATE_WARRIORS_4_Character_Pass_2/
